issues: Document is an inspection-body (орган инспекции) scope of accreditation table (ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 17020-2012), not a testing-laboratory table: it has no показатель/диапазон/единица columns (no measurable indicator ranges exist in this document type). Column mapping used: indicator = "Наименование вида инспекции" (col2: оценка/экспертиза/обследование/прямые измерения), object = "Область инспекции (подобласть)/стадия инспекции" (col3), norm_doc = "Документы, устанавливающие требования к объектам инспекции" (col6). okpd2_code and tnved_code columns (cols 4-5) are '-' (null) on every row. A separate "Документы, устанавливающие методы инспекции" column (col7) has no dedicated schema field; it is fully preserved as the last segment of raw_row_text for every row and repeats a standard citation (Приказ Роспотребнадзора от 19.07.2007 № 224) for almost all rows, with one added citation for row 9 (ionizing radiation) and equipment-verification citations for rows 14-15 (linear-measurement rows). No ТР ТС / раздел heading rows exist anywhere in the document (ТР ТС references for food-production row 8 appear only inline inside the col6 documents list, not as full-width heading rows), so tr_section is null on every row per the rules. Table rows have no numbering for repeated вид-инспекции sub-entries sharing the same object (экспертиза/обследование rows following a numbered оценка row carry no own №); these are still emitted as separate JSON rows since each represents a distinct вид инспекции + объект combination. All pages transcribed; no illegible content encountered; no page rotation was needed (all pages already landscape A4).
